critique.good: 第 4 列拿到 131px（110px 文字宽），事件文本最宽松，表格最矮（428px），整体节奏最紧；4 行中文服务名各自完整，没有拆字。
critique.problems: 最致命的是状态列被压到 72px（仅 51px 文字宽），'✅正常 / ⚠️降级 / ❌故障' 全部断成两行，图标与文字标签分家，扫读异常这个首要任务直接失效；第 1 行也因此从 36px 涨到 60px。
critique.cause: col2 72px 减去 21px 内边距只剩 51px，小于状态单元格一行所需的 54px，差 3px 就触发换行。col1 81px 只是刚好卡住 4 字中文名（60+21=81，零余量），API Gateway 只能折行——这是可接受的取舍，但不是状态列被牺牲的理由。

critique.good: 健康度两列（78/78）都保住了单行：状态图标+文字、99.99% 均不折行，前两秒的视线扫读是通的；列 2 与列 3 同宽，形成一个稳定的双列块。

critique.cause: col1 94px 是纯浪费——它既没能让 API Gateway 单行（需要 108px），又比 4 字中文名所需的最小 81px 多占了 13px；这 13px 全部从本已最紧张的事件列里抢走，把 5 行变 6 行。

critique.good: col1 108px 让 'API Gateway' 整体不折行，行标识完整，第 1 行保持 36px；支付服务/消息推送/对象存储/CDN 四个标识也稳。

understanding.purpose: 运维服务状态看板：每行一项服务，读者要快速判断哪些服务出了问题、影响多大、最近发生了什么。它是一个“扫读异常”的表，不是逐字阅读的文档。
understanding.reading: 先沿第 1 列锁定服务名（行锚点），再纵扫第 2 列的状态图标和文字找异常（✅正常 / ⚠️降级 / ❌故障），接着用第 3 列的可用率做定量比较，最后横向读第 4 列了解事件详情。前两秒的视线基本停在状态列上，详情列只有在前三列触发兴趣后才会被读。
groups: 第 2 列状态与第 3 列可用率：同属“健康度”信号，一质一量、紧邻对读，应同宽或近似同宽，形成稳定的双列块
第 1 列服务名：独立的行标识列，只需容纳标识符，不与健康块混同
第 4 列最近事件：唯一的自由文本列，性质与其他三列完全不同，是天然的“弹性列”
keep_intact: 可用率数值 99.99% / 97.40%（数字+百分号绝不可断行）
状态图标与其文字标签（✅正常、⚠️降级、❌故障）必须同行，拆开会让扫读失效
中文服务名 支付服务/消息推送/对象存储（4 字，约 60px），断行会破坏标识
理想情况下 API Gateway 整体不断（需 87px 内容宽，成本高，可视策略取舍）
may_wrap: 最近事件的长句（中文可在任意字间断行，是唯一真正的软文本）
事件中的时间戳 03:12 尽量不拆，但拆开只影响局部可读性
API Gateway 可在空格处折成两行（仅 1 行受影响，其余行不变高）

bad.why: col1 at 82px leaves 61px of text — just under the 60px four-character service names — so 支付服务/消息推送/对象存储 all break into 2+2 syllables, turning the row-label column into a ragged stack while the 1–2px needed to fix it sit idle in 可用率/最近事件.
Same fault, one pixel worse: at 81px every four-character service name wraps, so the reader can no longer take the leftmost column in one glance and rows lose their anchoring label.

Giving 服务 108px to one-line 'API Gateway' steals 25px from 最近事件, crushing the prose column to 80px — events now run 6 lines, 2-word fragments per line ('慢，已切换/至备用通道'), the table grows to 521px and the event text, the actual payload, becomes the hardest thing to read.

col1 82px still splits the service names, and the extra width handed to 状态 (78) buys nothing while 最近事件 drops to 124px, pushing one event to 5 lines and the table to 451px — worse on both axes than r2A.

Plausible-looking ('give the label column room, trim the chatter'), but it over-funds 服务 by 12px that no string needs while 状态/可用率 keep their minimum and 最近事件 loses a line of measure, making the event prose noticeably more chopped than r2A for no gain anywhere.

contrast.why: Plausible-looking ('give the label column room, trim the chatter'), but it over-funds 服务 by 12px that no string needs while 状态/可用率 keep their minimum and 最近事件 loses a line of measure, making the event prose noticeably more chopped than r2A for no gain anywhere.

final.rationale: The table has two jobs: identify the service (a fixed short label) and explain what happened (variable prose). The label column therefore only needs to clear 83px — enough for four Chinese characters on one line — and every pixel beyond that is taken directly from the only column that actually wants space. 状态 and 可用率 are compact, one-line, fixed-format fields (icon+word, percentage) that must simply not wrap; they need ~75px each and no more, which is exactly what r2A/r2C give them. 最近事件 then gets ~105px of measure, keeping events at 4 lines and the table at 428px, which is the tightest readable version. The 1px variations among r2A/r2B/r2C are visually indistinguishable; the real fault line is at col1 = 82, where service names split and the whole left edge starts to crumble.

general: A short-identifier column's width is set by its longest full entry, not by its longest word: the Chinese four-character names and 'API Gateway' define two different targets (83 vs 108), and paying for the second is usually a bad trade against a prose column.
Compact fixed-format columns (status, percentage) need exactly 'header or value + padding' and nothing more; slack given there is stolen from the flexible prose column.

Break a label column only if the alternative costs a lot elsewhere — a 2px shortfall that splits every row label is a worse defect than a slightly narrow text column, because it damages the reader's row-anchoring.
In narrow widths, one extra line in a prose column is cheap; one extra line in the label column multiplied by every row is expensive in scannability.
specific: Service names are all exactly four characters (60px), so 服务 is a step function: 83px = one line, 82px = two lines for three of five rows.
可用率's header (54px) and its values are the same width, so 75px is a hard floor with no reason to exceed it.
The emoji-led 最近事件 entries (clock, family, flags) can break anywhere, so that column tolerates narrow measure better than 服务 does — but only up to a point; at ~80px it fragments badly.

final.tradeoffs: Some would spend 108px on 服务 to keep 'API Gateway' on one line (r3B) and argue a clean label column beats event prose; others accept 'API Gateway' wrapping to two lines as the price of a readable event column — r2A takes the second view because that wrap costs one row, while a narrow event column costs four.
final.uncertain: Whether 1px differences (r2A vs r2B vs r2C) deserve separate names at all — they render identically; and whether the 82px designs are 'bad' or merely 'second best', since Chinese wrapping at a character boundary is not a mid-word split.

A.why: 最近事件 is squeezed into a narrow ribbon, breaking into 5–6 short lines while 状态 gets nearly as much width; rows become tall and the event text is hard to scan.

B.why: 状态 collapses to about 30px: the header splits 状/态 and every status stacks vertically, destroying at-a-glance comparison of the key categorical column.

C.why: Balanced allocation: service names stay intact (API Gateway breaks only at its space), status and availability fit on one line, and 最近事件 gets the remaining width in a readable block.

D.why: Essentially the same sound allocation as C: compact status/availability, intact service labels, and the surplus width goes to the event column.

E.why: The service column is too narrow: 支付服务, 消息推送 and 对象存储 break mid-word, weakening row identity, while 最近事件 still wraps to the same four lines.

F.why: Like E, service labels split mid-word with no visible gain in event readability; the first column is sacrificed for little benefit.

reviews.unsure: C and D look nearly identical, as do E and F; exact pixel widths and whether A leaves part of the available width unused are hard to confirm from the renders.

A.why: 服务 column keeps 4-character names and two-word 'API Gateway' wrapping acceptably at the space; 状态 and 可用率 each stay on one line and read as compact status/percentage columns. Cost: the 状态 column carries visible slack around '✅ 正常' while 最近事件 is squeezed to five short lines, so the prose column—the one that actually needs room—is the most cramped.

B.why: 服务 is too narrow: '支付服务', '消息推送', '对象存储' all break mid-word into '支付服 / 务' etc., which is exactly the kind of identifier/name splitting to avoid. Meanwhile 状态 keeps generous slack and 最近事件 is no wider than in A, so the squeeze buys nothing.

C.why: Essentially the same allocation as B: 服务 still breaks three-character-plus service names across lines, while 状态 and 可用率 sit in comfortable but underused columns. Row rhythm is consistent and nothing overflows, but the word-splitting in the key identifier column is a real typographic defect.

D.why: Best proportion of the set: 服务 holds every name intact, 状态 is sized to icon+'正常/降级' with little waste, 可用率 just fits '99.99%', and the freed width goes to 最近事件, so the prose column is the widest and lines are least fragmented. Header hierarchy stays clear and rows still read as units.

E.why: 状态 is far too narrow: the header stacks vertically as '状 / 态' and every status word breaks character-by-character ('正 / 常', '降 / 级', '故 / 障'), destroying the scan path for the most important at-a-glance column. 服务 still wraps 'API Gateway', so the sacrificed column doesn't even buy intact names.

F.why: The 最近事件 column is starved: event text shatters into five or six two-to-four-character fragments ('03:12 起 / 部分银行 / 卡渠道响…'), making the narrative unreadable as sentences, while 服务, 状态 and 可用率 are all generously sized with dead space. Proportions are inverted relative to content need.

reviews.unsure: A and D look nearly identical in the rendering (both keep service names intact and wrap 最近事件 similarly); my preference for D rests on slightly tighter 状态/可用率 columns and marginally wider 最近事件, which is hard to verify at this resolution. B and C also appear practically identical to me—if they differ by a few pixels in 服务, I could not see it.
